name: Event Marker S19: Phantom Event Guard (session.closed + is_valid)
description: Tests S19 phantom event guard: session.closed fires on gap days, is_valid(session.open) filters them. Validates .opened/.closed mutual exclusivity. Run over a period with holidays (MLK Day Jan 15).
source:
# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKER S19: Phantom Event Guard
# Tests: session.closed on gap days, is_valid(session.open) filter,
#        .opened/.closed mutual exclusivity
# Run period MUST include a holiday (Jan 15 = MLK Day) to verify phantom guard
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === RTH SESSION ===
rth = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === S19 PATTERN: Guard .closed with is_valid(session.open) ===
# CORRECT: filters phantom close events on gap/holiday days
real_close = rth.closed and is_valid(rth.open)

# UNGUARDED: bare .closed — may fire on gap days
bare_close = rth.closed

# === MEASURED VALUES (at session close) ===
rth_range = rth.high - rth.low
rth_return = (rth.close - rth.open) / rth.open

# === GUARDED EVENT OUTPUTS ===
guarded_range = where(real_close, rth_range)
guarded_return = where(real_close, rth_return)

# === REPORTERS ===

# Guarded event marker — should have clean data, no phantom events
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.AlertCircleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RTH Range", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="RTH Return", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="Guarded RTH Close (S19)"
    )
)(guarded_range, guarded_return, real_close)

# RTH range line for visual context
xy_lines(
    title="RTH Range",
    category="Sessions",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Range", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rth_range)
